neighbours.label: the second, parallel subject in a paired clause ('my dog needs a walk and your dog needs a bath'); a best guess for a diffuse pole
fire: If my son wants pizza and your son wants tacos, we will order both.
If her car needs gas and his car needs oil, stop at the garage.
My sister plays violin and your sister plays cello in the same band.
If your cat needs shots and my cat needs a checkup, let's go together.
The Lakers have to win and the Celtics have to lose tonight.
Your teacher wants essays and my teacher wants reports by Monday.
If his phone needs charging and her phone needs repair, use the shop.
Our team has to score and their team has to defend for ten minutes.
quiet: If my son wants pizza, we will order from the place near the park.
If her car needs gas, there is a station at the next corner.
My sister plays violin in a band that tours during the summer.
If your cat needs shots, the vet opens at eight on most days.
The Lakers played well last night and won by almost twenty points.
Your teacher wants essays by Monday, so start writing this weekend.
If his phone needs charging, the cable is in the kitchen drawer.
Our team scored early and then defended for the last ten minutes.

notes: Most of the pole's top examples show no such parallel, so coverage will be low even if this holds.
